exact_added_ci_command.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ucx_inst=/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/ucx-review-20261110/install/candidate
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${ucx_inst}/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
MPIRUN_COMMON="mpirun --allow-run-as-root --bind-to none"
log_warning() { printf '%s\n' "$*"; }
run_overlap_ci() {
				echo "==== Running CUDA IPC overlap regression ===="
				local overlap_status=0
				# Let the test report SKIP when CUDA IPC is unavailable.
				# Select installed libraries after MPI sets up its environment;
				# bypass the libtool wrapper's build-tree library paths.
				${MPIRUN_COMMON} -np 2 -mca pml ucx -mca pml_ucx_tls any \
					env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${ucx_inst}/lib:${ucx_inst}/lib/ucx:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH} \
					UCX_MODULE_DIR=${ucx_inst}/lib/ucx \
					UCX_TLS=sm,self,cuda_copy,cuda_ipc \
					UCX_RNDV_THRESH=1 UCX_RNDV_SCHEME=get_zcopy \
					UCX_LOG_LEVEL=trace ./test/mpi/.libs/test_cuda_ipc_overlap \
					|| overlap_status=$?
				if [ "$overlap_status" -eq 77 ]; then
					log_warning "CUDA IPC overlap regression skipped"
				elif [ "$overlap_status" -ne 0 ]; then
					return "$overlap_status"
				fi
}
run_overlap_ci

build_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ucx_review_root=$PWD
cd source
./autogen.sh > ../logs/autogen.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_review_root"
cd build
../source/contrib/configure-release --prefix="$ucx_review_root/install/candidate" \
    --enable-logging --enable-mt --disable-static --without-go --without-java \
    --without-rocm --with-mpi --with-cuda=/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1 \
    --with-gdrcopy=/usr CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ \
    CFLAGS='-O3 -g -march=znver3' > ../logs/configure.log 2>&1
ucx_link_flags="-Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucp/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/uct/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucs/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucm/.libs"
make -j8 LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/build.log 2>&1
make install LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/install.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_review_root"
gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include \
    ipc_trace.c -ldl -pthread -o ipc_trace.so
gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include \
    inject.c -ldl -o inject.so
mpicc -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include mpi_repro.c \
    -L/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/lib64 -lcudart -o mpi_repro
python3 -B tests.py
